Project Kickoff Agenda
-   0–10 min — Goals and scope
- Confirm project objective, success criteria, and boundaries.
- Align on what is in scope for phase 1.
-   10–20 min — Milestones and timeline
- Review major milestones, target dates, and dependencies.
- Confirm any fixed external deadlines.
-   20–35 min — Roles and owners
- Assign owner for each workstream.
- Confirm decision-maker, approver, and day-to-day lead.
-   35–45 min — Risks and blockers
- Identify top delivery risks, resourcing gaps, and open assumptions.
- Agree on mitigation owners for each major risk.
-   45–55 min — Operating cadence
- Set weekly check-in rhythm, status format, and escalation path.
- Confirm where decisions, notes, and action items will live.
-   55–60 min — Next steps
- Recap decisions made.
- Confirm immediate actions, owners, and due dates before close.
Scheduling Notes
Context used:
- All times interpreted in   America/New York  .
- A slot is considered viable only if each participant is free for the   entire 60-minute window  .
